assignment: For the 8 api-side shape-match schemas, enumerate insert/update call sites, classify bang vs non-bang, map to route/pipeline; deep-check accounts/{webauthn_credential,user_session,user_email_token}.ex for the same shape and rule fold-in-or-backlog.
verdict: CENSUS-CORRECTING: 7 of the 8 named api-side files (all but auth/api_token.ex) already declare assoc_constraint, which IS a foreign_key_constraint under the hood (Ecto raises Ecto.ConstraintError on any DB constraint violation the changeset does not declare, for BOTH Repo.insert and Repo.insert! alike) -- they do not match the 'zero foreign_key_constraint' shape and are NOT open FK-abort scars. Only auth/api_token.ex is a genuine open instance: two real references() FK columns (workspace_id, owner_user_id), zero assoc_constraint/foreign_key_constraint, 8 insert/update call sites, all non-bang (Repo.insert/Repo.update, none bang), softest reachable route is POST /v1/auth/tokens under [:user_auth, :require_user] (any authenticated user, not admin) via create_personal_access_token/3 -- but workspace_id there is server-derived (default_workspace_id()), never client-supplied, so the crash trigger is a race (workspace deleted concurrently) not attacker input. accounts/{webauthn_credential,user_session,user_email_token}.ex all cast a real NOT NULL references(:users, on_delete: :delete_all) user_id AND all three already declare assoc_constraint(:user) -- they fail the shape-match test the same way the other 7 do. Fold-in recommendation: do NOT fold the accounts/ trio into the fence -- they are structurally out of scope (already guarded), not open backlog.
